title: Extrude a rectangle as a new body up To Object the round face of a cylinder in another body above it (a click on a curved face while extruding)

expect.note: The new body is the post alone. Cylinder R30 along X through (y 15, z 40) in the first body; the post 40 x 10 rises to its underside z(y) = 40 - sqrt(900 - (y - 15)^2): 40 * int_0^10 z dy = 40 * (400 - 281.1725319) = 4753.0987 (int sqrt(r^2-u^2) du = (u sqrt(r^2-u^2) + r^2 asin(u/r))/2), highest at y 0 (z 40 - sqrt(675)). FreeCAD's Pad 'up to face' on a curved face of another body started the post part way up; SciForge's own extrude feature builds it.
